name: Mukaishima (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Mukaishima town emblem in red: a stylised device of a broad chevron-topped shape above a horizontal bar.
history: Flag of the former town of Mukaishima in Hiroshima Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-03-28. The municipal emblem was adopted in 1961.

features.role: Mukaishima town emblem — a stylised device of a broad chevron-topped shape above a horizontal bar
